prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with concussion after a parking lot collision. The patient had 30 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1163; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- It is not yet clear whether the injury came from this crash.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a low-speed collision in a parking lot with reported headache, dizziness, light sensitivity, and difficulty concentrating. Neurological examination and imaging findings clearly confirm the concussion diagnosis. Causation relative to this specific crash has not yet been fully established, and further records will be reviewed to clarify the relationship between the event and the current presentation. No prior injury to the head or neck region is known to this provider. Care consisted of 30 visits including symptom monitoring, vestibular and vision-focused therapy, graduated cognitive rest recommendations, and periodic reassessment. The treatment course followed a typical trajectory, with visit frequency tapering as symptoms improved and functional capacity returned. Billing records reflect single entries for each service without repeated charges for the same care. Patient is currently progressing and will continue follow-up as clinically indicated.
